import os, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
v = os.environ["NODESTEER_PARAM_password"]
mode = os.environ["NODESTEER_PARAM_mode"]
tag = os.environ["NODESTEER_TEST_MARKER"]
for b in v.encode():
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(bytes([b])); sys.stdout.flush()
    sys.stderr.buffer.write(bytes([b])); sys.stderr.flush()
    time.sleep(0.025)
if mode == "live":
    print("LIVE-START-" + tag, flush=True)
    time.sleep(4)
    for i in range(80):
        print("LIVE-LINE-%03d-%s" % (i, tag), flush=True)
        time.sleep(0.04)
    time.sleep(4)
    print("LIVE-TAIL-" + tag, flush=True)
    print("LIVE-ERR-TAIL-" + tag, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
elif mode == "retry":
    marker = Path(tag)
    count = int(marker.read_text()) if marker.exists() else 0
    marker.write_text(str(count + 1))
    print("RETRY-ATTEMPT-%d-TAIL-%s" % (count + 1, tag), flush=True)
    print("RETRY-ERR-ATTEMPT-%d" % (count + 1), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    if count == 0:
        sys.exit(7)
    marker.unlink(missing_ok=True)
elif mode == "cancel":
    print("CANCEL-TAIL-" + tag, flush=True)
    print("CANCEL-ERR-TAIL-" + tag, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    time.sleep(120)
elif mode == "timeout":
    print("TIMEOUT-TAIL-" + tag, flush=True)
    print("TIMEOUT-ERR-TAIL-" + tag, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    time.sleep(20)
else:
    print("UNEXPECTED-MODE", flush=True)
